name: KSTDC Hotel Mayura Barid Shahi
area: Udgir Road, near Ambedkar Circle, central Bidar
signature_dish: Vegetarian multi-cuisine meals at the government tourism hotel
why_it_matters: The Karnataka State Tourism Development Corporation hotel in Bidar, near Ambedkar Circle on Udgir Road, about ten minutes' walk from the railway station and close to Gurudwara Nanak Jhira Sahib and Bidar Fort. Its vegetarian multi-cuisine restaurant is the dependable government-property meal for travellers doing the fort and the Bahmani-era monuments.
insider_tip: Its location is the strength — central and close to Nanak Jhira Sahib and the fort, so it works for a meal between sights. Standard government-hotel hours; the veg thali and South Indian breakfast are the safe orders.
signature_address: Udgir Road, near Ambedkar Circle, Bidar, Karnataka 585401

name: Shama Biryani Hotel
area: Station Road, near Bidar railway station, Bidar
why_it_matters: Bidar is the birthplace of Kalyani biryani — the buffalo-meat, tomato-and-coriander biryani that grew out of the town's Bahmani-Nawabi past and is called the 'poor man's Hyderabadi biryani'. Shama Biryani Hotel near the railway station is the most-reviewed biryani address in Bidar (nearly 300 ratings), the practical place to taste the city's signature dish.
insider_tip: Bidar's biryani is its defining dish — order it here rather than the multi-cuisine sidelines. It is busy at lunch and the biryani can run out by late afternoon. No-frills, near the station, easy for an arrival or departure meal.
signature_address: Station Road, near Bidar railway station, Bidar, Karnataka 585401

name: Kamat Hotel
area: Near Bidar main bus stand, central Bidar
why_it_matters: A pure-veg restaurant near the Bidar main bus stand, currently the top-ranked restaurant in Bidar on Tripadvisor for its tasty vegetarian South Indian thali. It also runs North Indian curries, chaat and pav bhaji at reasonable prices — the reliable, central veg anchor for travellers in a town better known for its biryani.
insider_tip: Next to the bus stand, so it is the easy first or last meal in Bidar. The veg South Indian thali is the order most reviewers single out; curries run a modest ₹100-150. Quick service, cash-friendly.
signature_address: Near Bidar main bus stand, Bidar, Karnataka 585401

name: Rohit Restaurant
signature_dish: Punjabi vegetarian curries with tandoori roti
why_it_matters: A popular vegetarian restaurant in Bidar focused on North Indian and Punjabi cooking, Tripadvisor-listed and well-liked for reasonable prices and a pleasant dining room. It is a solid sit-down veg dinner option alongside Kamat for travellers who want Punjabi-style curries rather than biryani.
insider_tip: Go for the Punjabi staples — paneer and dal dishes with tandoori roti are what the kitchen does best. Reviewers note balanced, not over-spiced cooking, good if you want milder North Indian food.

name: Guruprasad Udupi Veg Restaurant
why_it_matters: An Udupi-cuisine pure-veg restaurant in Bidar, recommended for good South Indian cooking at low prices — dosas, uttapams, filter coffee and a full-course meal. It carries the Udupi brand of brisk, clean, vegetarian tiffin to a town in the far north of Karnataka, a dependable budget breakfast and lunch stop.
insider_tip: Best for a South Indian breakfast or a quick full meal — the dosas, uttapams and filter coffee are the picks. Clean, frequent table service; budget-friendly.
